prompt: Summarize the excerpt from 'dmoi3-tablet' (chunk 57.3) about mathematics: A function is injective provided every element of the codomain is the image of at most one element from the domain. A fu
true_answer: A function is injective provided every element of the codomain is the image of at most one element from the domain. A function is surjective provided every element of the codomain is the image of at least one element from the domain. Notice both properties are determined by what happens to elements of the codomain: they could be repeated as images or they could be “missed” (not be images). Injective functions do not have repeats but might or might not miss elements. Surjective functions do not miss elements, but might
